name: Майстер перетворення пішаків (1)
description:
Do you remember? If a pawn succeeds in crossing the board, you have to exchange it for a queen, a rook, a bishop or a knight. This is called promotion.
Of course, the other does not want to let that happen. What if he is going to do something against your plan?

In this lesson, the black king will try to stop your pawn. He races the pawn to the promotion square. But he is always too late. That is because the king is too far away.

You can see if the king can overtake your pawn by looking at the square. You can find the square by counting the squares in front of the pawn and then counting an equal number of squares to the side.

The king stands in the square area. He can catch the pawn, whether White is to move or Black. 

 

If the king outside the square, the pawn can safely promote.

 

Now look at the examples.
In example 1, you learn to find the square.
In example 2, you see that you can sometimes promote nonetheless, even though the king is inside the square.

 

What should you do?

Promote your pawn, but make sure that the new piece cannot be captured.

examples.pgn: {[%csl Ye5][%cal Yh5h8,Yh8e8,Ye8e5]} {[#]} 1. h6 Ke6 2. h7 Kf7 3. h8=Q *
examples.text:
The pawn needs three steps to reach the other side. The black king needs four steps to get to the corner. With White to move, this means that the king is too late to stop the pawn.
Click on the arrow to watch the moves.

Now, look at the square. If the king were inside the yellow square, he would be able to catch up with the pawn.

examples.pgn: {[%csl Rg7][%cal Yh5h8,Yh8e8,Ye8e5]} {[#]} 1. h6 Kf7 2. h7 Kg6 3. h8=Q *
examples.text:
This time the king is inside the square (see yellow arrows). There is only one problem for Black. The knight stands in the way of the king! If White’s pawn walks on, Black cannot stop it.
Click on the arrow to watch the moves.

Have you noticed that the white pawn didn't take the knight? That would give White extra points, but he won't win! Black’s king would recapture the pawn. Then, both players have only a king and the game would end in a draw.

White has to wait before earning points. He does that when he queens his pawn. White gains 8 points (+9=queen -1=pawn).

With queen against knight, White should be able to win the game.

texts: It's almost always best to promote to a queen.
